import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    L = np.log(1+eps)
    a = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]*T**2
    K = np.exp(p[3] + p[4]*T + p[5]*T**2)
    n = p[6] + p[7]*T
    e0 = np.exp(p[8] + p[9]*T)
    return a + K*(L+e0)**n
